title: feat(spec)!: composeStacks refuses a flat composition that puts two or more apps under one app or module package id, and every packages[] body is held to one app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMGEMhgToFuf1jDhYKP9RbM)_

Fixes #32810

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32977 (skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md); skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md carried by #32809

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `composeStacks` 扁平组合（默认 `manifest: 'last'`、`'first'` 或下标）若把两个以上应用放到同一个 app/module 包 id 下，现在会被拒（`STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`，422），报错写出包 id、每个应用来自哪个输入、以及改用 `manifest: 'preserve'`；`defineStack` 与 `composeStacks` 也按同一规则判每个 `packages[]` 包体；结果带 `packages[]` 时，没有任何包体声明的顶层应用（例如 preserve 下没有 manifest 的输入带来的应用）会被加载路径登记到制品 manifest 的 id 下，现在和该 id 包体自己的应用一起判。`defineStack` 的报错文案补上 preserve 改法，包类型标签从类型推导。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0019 D3 修订后要求一个包至多一个应用；#32586 只在 `defineStack` 判单个包，扁平组合会把各包的应用合到一个包 id 下，没有任何一道门拦。
- **风险与回滚：** 收窄。本仓无产品调用方命中（唯一产品调用 `examples/app-multi-package` 已用 preserve），7 个 spec 测试夹具与一页入门文档按席位同意的方式改了；hotcrm 的测试视图 `test/helpers/composed-stack.ts` 是扁平组合，升级到含本改动的版本前要先迁（平台读法卡 #32827）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `collectComposedSingleAppErrors`（及 `flatSingleAppFinding` / `residualSingleAppFinding`）与 `composeBuiltStacks` 第 3c 步；同文件 `singleAppFinding` / `validateSingleApp`；`packages/spec/src/stack.test.ts` 新 describe。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack.test.ts -t "composeStacks — at most one App"`，预期 11 条全绿，其中一条是「扁平组合 app 包与 module 包各一应用被拒，点名包、各应用来源与 preserve 改法」。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`composeStacks` judges what it puts under each package id** (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, new `collectComposedSingleAppErrors`, called as step 3c of `composeBuiltStacks`, after the artifact cross-reference pass — the order `defineStack` runs its cross-reference and single-app refusals in):
  - A flat composition (`manifest: 'last'`, the default, `'first'` or an index) of inputs that carry no `packages[]` keeps one manifest and concatenates every input's `apps` under it: its result is one package. When that manifest is an `app` or `module` package and the result holds two or more apps, it is refused with `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (422), header `composeStacks single-app validation failed (N issues):`. The finding names the package, each app with the input it came from and the remedy, e.g. "A 'module' package must define at most one app, but composeStacks with manifest: 'last' gives package 'com.example.crm.service' 2 ('crm_sales' from 'com.example.crm' (stack #0), 'crm_service' from 'com.example.crm.service' (stack #1)): a composition that keeps one manifest puts every input's apps under that one package id. Keep one app per package and compose the packages into one artifact with composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' }), which keeps each package's own id (a flat composition puts every app back under one) — ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended (a suite may surface several apps, one per package)."
  - Every `packages[]` body the result carries is judged by its own `type`, `id` and `apps`, under every manifest option.
  - **The apps no package body declares** (added in `91fca555`, answering contract-review should-fix S1 in record 6839703155). A result that carries `packages[]` registers each body under its own id, and the boot's residual rule (`unclaimedTopLevel` in `@objectstack/metadata`, mirrored in this file by `isResidualTopLevelItem`) registers every top-level app that no body declares under the artifact's manifest id. Under every manifest option those apps are now counted together with the apps of the body that carries that id, and two or more, at least one of them residual, are refused (`residualSingleAppFinding`). That closes a `'preserve'` composition whose input has no manifest but brings an app, which the first head accepted, and it stops counting a nested artifact's flattened copies of its bodies' apps against the kept manifest of a flat composition, which the first head over-refused. A one-app-per-package `'preserve'` composition, where every input that defines an app carries a manifest, leaves no residual app and builds as before.
  - A single-input composition is still handed back untouched (the early return), judged only by its own `defineStack`, and not at all when that input was built with `strict: false`.
- **`defineStack` judges every `packages[]` body too** (`validateSingleApp` now adds `collectPackageBodySingleAppErrors`), so a hand-assembled artifact whose body defines two apps is refused at the door it enters. The stack's own package is judged as before; the read `const type = config.manifest?.type` that the `manifest.type` liveness evidence quotes is unchanged.
- **One finding builder per package** (`singleAppFinding`, for the authored stack and every `packages[]` body; a composition's result is judged by `flatSingleAppFinding` and `residualSingleAppFinding` with the same predicate and constants): review nit N3 — the remedy now names `composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })`; review nit N2 — the package-type label is derived from the type (`An 'app' package`, `A 'module' package`), not two hard-coded strings. The words "must define at most one app" stay, which `packages/cli/test/generate-scaffolds-reach-stack.e2e.test.ts` and `stack-refusal-envelopes.test.ts` match. Nit N1 (the module finding offers no fold remedy) is unchanged. A package with no `id` (reachable only through `strict: false`) is printed by its `name`, as `stackLabel` does, not as `'undefined'` (contract-review nit N4).
- **Records:** the `StackSingleAppViolationError` docblock names its two raise sites; the `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` ledger comment in `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` says the same (enum member, family and status untouched); the `composeStacks` TSDoc and the `manifest` option's doc state the rule.
- **ADR-0087:** a new semantic entry, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.compose-stacks-flat-second-app-refused.ts` (`adr-0087: registered compose-stacks-flat-second-app-refused`), no D2 conversion — whether the inputs are one package or several, and which app stays where, is the author's call.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32810-compose-stacks-single-app.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING banner, Before / Now / Unchanged / Fix; the Fix names the flat-composition-as-a-test-view usage and its move.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` § Composition Pattern taught `composeStacks([CrmApp, TodoApp])`, two app packages with an app each composed flat, which this change refuses. It now composes with `{ manifest: 'preserve' }` and says why (added to the claim's file surface by the seat).

## Why

ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended: a suite may surface several apps, each defined by a different package, and no package defines more than one — the Console addresses an app by its package id, read by its id a multi-app package answers as absent, and disabling a module removes the app that module owns. #32586 (merged `9ae829108c`) enforced it per authored package in `defineStack`. On `origin/main` `2ca09de55`, `validateSingleApp` had one caller (`defineStack`), and `composeStacks` concatenated `apps` under its one selected manifest without judging the result, so the default composition of a suite produced exactly the removed shape, and the #32586 finding's remedy did not say to compose under `preserve`. Declared means enforced.

## Measured: who composes suite packages, and with which `manifest` option

Read-only. objectstack at `2ca09de55` (the branch point); hotcrm at `8277e61` (shallow clone of `main`, read-only); the shipped templates are this repo's `packages/create-objectstack`.

| Tree | Caller | `manifest` | Affected |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack `2ca09de55` | `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts:68` (orders module + core app) | `'preserve'` | no — builds unchanged |
| | `packages/**/src`, `ui/**` | — | no call site: the hits are comments and `ui/packages/core`'s deprecated re-export |
| | `packages/create-objectstack` (one bundled template, `blank`) | — | no `composeStacks` |
| | tests outside `packages/spec`: 52 files in cli, runtime, metadata, objectql, core, plugin-dev, plugin-security, service-automation, verify | flat and `'preserve'` | no — all green against the new `dist` (see Verification) |
| | `packages/spec` tests | flat | 7 tests in 5 files sat on two apps under one package id: moved, see Tests |
| | `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx:324` | flat | yes — rewritten to `'preserve'` |
| hotcrm `8277e61` | `objectstack.config.ts:56`, the artifact (5 packages; sales, service, marketing one app each; revenue, o2c none) | `'preserve'` | no — HotCRM's shape builds unchanged |
| | `test/helpers/composed-stack.ts:43`, a test view of every collection | flat (default `'last'`) | **yes** — selected manifest `app.objectstack.hotcrm` (`type: 'app'`) with three apps; refused at module load. 165 of 266 test files load it (158 directly, 7 through `test/helpers/flow-regions.ts` / `stack-picklists.ts`; static `git grep`, not a run). hotcrm pins `@objectstack/*` `18.3.0`, so nothing breaks before it bumps. Its move needs a public reader of a composed artifact's collections (`resolveArtifactCollections` is internal to `@objectstack/runtime`): filed by the seat as #32827, to land before or with the release that carries this |
| cloud | — | — | not in the card's list; not read (no access) |

Seat disposition of the measurement: ruled A by the lane seat in the card thread, not yet recorded on the card itself (contract review ③). Narrow as the card orders; the hotcrm move rides #32827 and the hotcrm lane.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack.test.ts`, new describe "composeStacks — at most one App per package, judged on what the composition puts under each package id": a flat composition (default `'last'`) of an app package and a module package with one app each is refused (envelope `code`, `status`, one issue, header), naming the package, both apps with their inputs and the preserve remedy; the same under `'first'` and index `0`, selecting the app package; the same packages under `'preserve'` build unchanged, each body carrying its one app; `defineStack` refuses a hand-assembled `packages[]` body with two apps, naming the body (`packages[0]`) and both apps; `composeStacks` refuses such a body that reached it through `strict: false`, under `'last'` and `'preserve'`; controls: a single-input composition is returned by identity, a flat composition whose inputs bring one app is accepted, and a flat composition whose selected manifest is a `plugin` package is not judged. The existing HotCRM planned-shape pin (preserve of an app package and three modules) is unchanged and green. Added in `91fca555`: a `'preserve'` composition whose input with no manifest brings an app is refused, naming the package, the body's app, the residual app and the remedy; a flat composition of a nested artifact whose flattened copy repeats its body's app, plus a module with one app, is accepted; a flat composition with a nested artifact and two further modules with an app each is refused, counting only the two residual apps; and a package with no `id` is named by its `name`.
- Moved fixtures (each disposition agreed with the seat before the edit):
  - `compose-stacks.test.ts` "should compose outputs of defineStack" pinned two app packages' apps under one id (`apps` length 2), the removed shape: the todo stack now carries no app (objects 2, last-wins manifest kept), and the two-app pair is asserted refused (`STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`, 422).
  - `compose-stacks-key-loss.test.ts` "concatenates in stack order", `compose-key-dispositions-export.pin.test.ts` pin 4 (every `concat` key) and `compose-stacks-concat-shape-refusal.test.ts`'s `apps` control: the subject is the concat pass, so the selected (last) manifest is a `plugin` package, which this rule does not judge; a comment beside each says so and says to retype it if a ruling ever holds `plugin` to one app.
  - `compose-stacks-manifest-preserve.test.ts`: the flat composition used as the reference (`bodiesReproduceFlattened`) and as the `objectConflict` CONTROL now composes a second package with no app (`withObjects(…, false)`); the `apps` comparison still reads one app.
- Ablation, first head (`dd30cfb0`; the spec tests import `src/`, so no `dist` leg), each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, running `stack.test.ts`, `compose-stacks.test.ts` and `compose-stacks-manifest-preserve.test.ts`; every leg restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD (`b18fea40`):
  - A — revert the composeStacks refusal (`collectComposedSingleAppErrors(...)` → `[]`): 4 red — the flat refusal, `'first'`/index, the `strict: false` body, and the moved `compose-stacks.test.ts` pin.
  - B — revert the `defineStack` body judgment: 1 red — the hand-assembled `packages[]` body.
  - C — revert N3 (remedy without `manifest: 'preserve'`): 2 red — the flat finding and the body finding.
  - D — mutation: judge the top level under `'preserve'` too: 2 red — the preserve control and the existing HotCRM planned-shape pin.
  - E — mutation: the count test loosened from "more than one app" to "at least one app": 5 red — the one-app flat control, the moved integration pin and the three preserve-file references.
- Ablation, `91fca555`, the same way and the same three files, each leg restored to the HEAD blob (`93e8d785`):
  - F — drop the residual judgment (a result with `packages[]` returns no finding): 2 red — the preserve residual refusal and the nested-artifact flat refusal.
  - G — mutation: count every top-level app whatever the result carries (the first head's flat rule under every option): 5 red — the existing HotCRM planned-shape pin, the preserve control, the preserve residual refusal (its wording), the nested-artifact acceptance and the nested-artifact refusal (its wording).
  - H — print `id` alone: 1 red — the package named by its `name`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Branch name.** The platform assigned `claude/project-thread-2eliu6` to this card thread, not `claude/issue-32810-*`; the restated claim (6836152532) names it.
- **Both doors judge `packages[]` bodies.** The card's Work line 2 says "judge each `packages[]` body by the same rule"; #32792's contract review (6833950860, ③ third flag) assigned "a module body with two apps inside a hand-built `packages[]` passes `defineStack`" to this card. So the body judgment sits in `defineStack` (strict) and in `composeStacks`; the seat agreed. `defineStack(…, { strict: false })` still skips it at `defineStack`, and `composeStacks` judges such a body when it is composed.
- **Not judged, by design:** a composition whose kept manifest is not `app` or `module` (`plugin` and the rest — whether `plugin` is held to one app has no ruling, and the measurement found no plugin caller that makes it matter, so no `open_question`); a composition that keeps no manifest.
- **A composition whose kept manifest is a `plugin` can still take an app package's app, or a residual app,** under the plugin's id. Out of scope with the plugin question above; reported, not built.
- **`composeStacks`'s object / action conflict arms are untouched** (ADR-0150 D4 work; #32672 pins those cells).
- **Skills-docs:** `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` § Multi-App Composition presents `composeStacks()` with its `manifest` strategies and does not say a suite composes under `'preserve'` (it also says no app in this repo uses it, while `examples/app-multi-package` does); `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § App Navigation says the refusal is `defineStack`'s for a `type: 'app'` package (already carried by #32809). Product PRs do not edit `skills/**`; the seat files the card.
- **Contract review.** Round 1 on `cf5a8840` (brief 6839695698, record 6839703155): PASS, with should-fix S1 (the top level was judged by the `manifest` option, while the load path decides by whether the result carries `packages[]`) and nits N1 to N5, all answered in `91fca555`. Delta round on `91fca555` (record 6840656371): PASS, no must-fix, no open should-fix; nits N6 to N9 left as accepted deviations. Its ③ raises one item for the seat, outside this card: `defineStack` still counts every top-level app of a `packages[]`-carrying stack against the stack's own manifest (on `main` since #32586, not moved here), which over-refuses an additive artifact and misses a hand-assembled stack with one undeclared app beside the same-id body's app.
- **hotcrm reader.** #32827 has a pull request open, #32928; it lands no later than the release that carries this change.
- **No `content/docs/releases/`, `CHANGELOG.md` or generated reference edits.**

No further merge of `main`: the lane seat parked this PR until the 18.4.0 version commit lands.
